generation.scope: A common marked slice with four reduced rank-one vertices forces opposite symmetry on its row and column coordinate positions whenever the mark has tangent dimension at most one, even if all local factors are nonreduced. The projected kernel cross product is supported on at most four socles, and cubic separation and the absence of pure relations exclude every nonsymmetric case.

open_mathematics: Use the length-four Frobenius trace model to extend the kernel-coordinate symmetry test to nonreduced rank-one slices. Analyze the remaining parity and planar marks, and the independent rank-nine branching problem.
